ns2:section.sectionText: STUDENTS INTERESTED IN BROADCAST JOURNALISM SHOULD CONSIDER THIS SECTION. Students who have completed JOUR 400 should not register for JOUR 210. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Journalism or Broadcast Journalism or Agricultural Communications major(s).
